evidence: including if the numerical value makes their account “Healthy,” “At-Risk,” or “Unhealthy.”

evidence: will be the determining factor for account suspension based on accumulated policy violations.

evidence: our team of dedicated Account Health Specialists is ready to support sellers over the phone or via email

claim: The Account Health dashboard in Seller Central monitors customer service, shipping performance and policy compliance.
evidence: Monitor your customer service, shipping performance, and policy compliance with the Account Health dashboard.

claim: The SP-API ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED notification is published when the account status changes between NORMAL, AT_RISK and DEACTIVATED.
evidence: A notification is published whenever the selling partner's account status changes between NORMAL , AT_RISK , and DEACTIVATED .

claim: The Seller Performance Report (GET_V2_SELLER_PERFORMANCE_REPORT) contains the individual performance metrics from the Seller Central Account Health dashboard.
evidence: Contains the individual performance metrics data from the Seller Central Account Health dashboard.

claim: The Seller Performance Report includes an accountHealthRating object with ahrStatus, reportingDateRange and ahrScore.
evidence: accountHealthRating ahrStatus reportingDateRange ahrScore

claim: The Seller Performance Report lists policy categories including listingPolicyViolations, productAuthenticityCustomerComplaints, productSafetyCustomerComplaints, receivedIntellectualPropertyComplaints, restrictedProductPolicyViolations and customerProductReviewsPolicyViolations.
evidence: listingPolicyViolations productAuthenticityCustomerComplaints productConditionCustomerComplaints productSafetyCustomerComplaints receivedIntellectualPropertyComplaints restrictedProductPolicyViolations

claim: The Seller Performance Report's metric objects carry a reportingDateRange, status, targetValue and targetCondition alongside the count or rate.
evidence: reportingDateRange status targetValue targetCondition

claim: The Seller Performance Report also reports documentRequests and policyViolationWarnings, the latter with a warningsCount.
evidence: documentRequests policyViolationWarnings warningsCount

claim: The Flat File Feedback Report contains negative and neutral feedback (one to three stars).
evidence: Contains negative and neutral feedback (one to three stars) from buyers who rated the seller's performance.

claim: The Amazon Seller app shows banner alerts related to account health.
evidence: Watch for banner alerts related to your account health

claim: Seller Central lets sellers contact Seller Support with a question or request for help.
evidence: Contact Seller Support with a question or request for help.

evidence: Ongoing failure to meet requirements may lead to Prime offers being disabled and disenrollment from the program.
